architecture_contract.method: dual variational autoencoder with modality-specific RNA and chromosome-split ATAC encoders/decoders, stochastic cross-modal translators, and adversarial alignment
architecture_contract.released_variant_for_common_screen: scButterfly-B with no cell-type, cluster, or MultiVI augmentation
architecture_contract.native_variants: scButterfly-C, -T, and -TC may be separate native-lane runs only when augmentation is fit inside the outer-training partition. They are not representation-comparable to scButterfly-B.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No task-independent pretrained checkpoint is admitted. Fit one local state-dict bundle per outer fold and seed from permitted outer-training same-cell or same-nucleus pairs.

inductive_inference_contract.allowed_wrapper: A project adapter may call the frozen RNA encoder, RNA translator, and ATAC decoder directly in eval and no-grad mode using RNA query rows alone. It must attach the frozen training peak inventory itself.
inductive_inference_contract.forbidden: Do not call Butterfly.load_data/data_preprocessing/test_model on a combined train-plus-query object. Do not supply query ATAC, select features on query cells, update batch-normalization state, tune on query targets, or use test cells in augmentation.
inductive_inference_contract.upstream_api_audit: The released high-level API requires both RNA and ATAC matrices and preprocesses the entire supplied matrices before applying train/test IDs. Its bidirectional test routine also constructs both RNA and ATAC test loaders. It is therefore not an admissible inductive query path.
inductive_inference_contract.profile_validity: The direct RNA-to-ATAC decoder emits a sigmoid-valued vector in the training ATAC target space. Score it as a continuous accessibility score on the frozen peak inventory. Do not call it a count, probability, or calibrated binary accessibility profile without an outer-training-only calibration fixture.
inductive_inference_contract.inverse_tfidf_warning: The released inverse TF-IDF requires cell-specific library-size tiles and feature-frequency tiles from the ATAC matrix being inverted. Those quantities are unavailable for an RNA-only query and must never be derived from held ATAC. Inverse TF-IDF output is not admitted.

input_contract.atac: training-pair binary peak counts on a GRCh38.p14 peak inventory selected only from outer-training donors; any TF-IDF feature frequencies and global scale are fit only there
input_contract.pairing_requirement: Core training indexes RNA and ATAC rows as paired observations. Only exact same-cell or same-nucleus joins are allowed; different aliquots and study-unpaired cells are never presented as pairs.
input_contract.reference: GENCODE v49 stable gene identifiers and GRCh38.p14 0-based half-open peaks, with chromosome order and per-chromosome peak counts frozen
input_contract.rna: nonnegative UMI counts aligned to the training gene inventory; per-cell total normalization and log1p may be applied to query rows, but HVG selection is outer-training-only

missingness_contract.training: The released core model expects both modalities for every paired training row and does not consume project missing-state masks.
missingness_contract.inference: RNA-only inference is a source-to-target decoder operation, not missing-as-zero. The ATAC tensor is absent and must not be fabricated.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: Retain all eight project missingness states in manifests outside the model. Only observed modalities enter model tensors.

output_contract.cell_embedding: frozen RNA-encoder or RNA-translator embedding with the exact layer named in the RunSpec
output_contract.rna_to_atac: cell-by-frozen-peak continuous decoder scores, optionally donor-by-cell-state aggregated after inference
output_contract.known_upstream_defect: train_model.Model assigns ATAC_data_var from RNA_data.var. The adapter must ignore this metadata and attach the independently frozen ATAC peak table.

safe_loading_contract.required_fix: Replace unrestricted torch.load calls with a project-controlled local state-dict loader using weights-only semantics where supported, CPU-first inspection, exact key/shape/dtype manifests, and hash verification.

source_evidence: The exact repository revision, MIT license, source files, and public PyPI JSON metadata were inspected as text on 2026-08-22. PyPI distributions, dependencies, checkpoints, packages, and weights were not downloaded, installed, deserialized, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Candidate after frozen RNA-query, no-query-influence, preprocessing, and runtime fixtures pass.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Direct-profile candidate only as continuous frozen-peak decoder scores. Requires same-nucleus outer-training pairs and a no-query-ATAC adapter; inverse-TFIDF counts are ineligible.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because the model has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
